purpose: The unmodified upstream llama.cpp build used as the control for GenieX's llama_cpp plugin. Pinned, so a control run today is comparable with one run later. Change it deliberately and say why in the commit.
notes: Adreno OpenCL backend; it needs no test signing, unlike the Hexagon backend. llama-bench labels both -ngl 99 and -ngl 0 as OpenCL, the backend it loaded.
